assessment: Paid, guided observation tour of Palacio Barolo. Admission covers the building route, panoramic balconies and generally the lighthouse; the operator sells it as its own visitor experience. The tour has distinct ticket prices and reservations.

observations.address: Av. de Mayo 1370, Monserrat, Buenos Aires
observations.daytimeVisits: Wednesday through Monday by reservation; Tuesday closed; exact departure slots vary and must be checked in booking system.
observations.access: Fourteen floors by lift, then eight by narrow stairs; lighthouse may close during heavy rain or electrical storms.
